title: Quantum Tunneling from SDT Pressure Barrier Evanescence
equations: SDT: pressure evanescence in barrier: P(x) ~ exp(-kappa*x)
pipeline: 1. Compute transmission coefficient for rectangular barrier
2. Verify exponential dependence on barrier width
3. Verify mass dependence (heavier particles tunnel less)
conclusion: 6/6 tests pass. kappa = 1.146e+10 m^-1. SDT pressure evanescence reproduces tunneling barrier penetration.
